text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Hanshin JF approaching, news 
breaks one after another of GⅠ Umamusume 
being sidelined by injuries. That is just 
how unforgiving GⅠ races are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus and her Trainer reaffirmed 
the importance of proper maintenance and 
management.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later. Ikuno Dictus spoke with her peers, 
Mejiro Ryan and Ines Fujin. There, the 
topic turned to the injured Derby 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin shared her thoughts. While 
getting injured was regrettable, at the 
same time, she couldn't help but admire 
running with all one's heart and soul.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A run on a once-in-a-lifetime stage, 
wagering everything on a single moment. 
Ines Fujin smiled, expressing her desire 
to run like that too.
